independenceNote: This GENE-X case couples toroidal planes across GPUs through MPI halo exchanges. The live W7-X tubes are independent: GPU 0 advances the bean tube and GPU 1 the triangular tube with no exchange between them.

coverage.description: 4 controlled runs on the separate Dommaschk geometry (not W7-X); 6 toroidal planes over 2 ranks
